plan.title: AQ-OS System-1 Decision Plane + Autonomous Self-Compaction
plan.goal: Add a CPU-only System-1 microservice (system1d) for sub-30ms calibrated judgments across routing/RAG/memory/shell-safety/telemetry/reviewer-routing, plus agent-controlled self-compaction on the event spine. Security fail-CLOSED; performance fail-OPEN to System-2; shadow-first per function; APU-honest (400MB RSS, no VRAM).
success_criteria: system1d runs CPU-only under a 400MB RSS ceiling over a UNIX socket, declared as a shared-engine capability (fail-open to System-2 when absent)
shell-safety stays fail-closed: System-1 never widens what the existing gate permits; <0.90 confidence falls through to Tier-0/operator
self_compact emits an aq-event that projects RESUME.json/PULSE.log (never hand-written) — retires the D3 clobber class
routing picks always pass the lane-health filter before dispatch (System-1 proposes, health filter disposes)
each function lands shadow-first with logged agreement/latency before cutover; DoD attested per Rule 15
